summary: LibreSpeed, a self-hosted network speed test (download, upload, ping, jitter) with a web UI. The Go backend speedtest-go with the frontend embedded; results telemetry is off by default.

name: linkding
summary: Self-hosted bookmark manager with tags, full-text search, archived snapshots, a REST API and browser extensions, on SQLite or PostgreSQL. Built from source (Django in a venv, npm-built frontend) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: linkerd-cni
summary: Linkerd's CNI plugin (the alternative to the proxy-init init container), its installer and the Rust cni-repair-controller, built from source from the linkerd/linkerd2-proxy-init cni-plugin tag with upstream's image layout, so the linkerd2-cni chart runs it unchanged. A privileged node agent by design.

name: linkerd-control-plane
summary: Linkerd's control plane `controller` binary (destination, identity, proxy-injector, sp-validator, service-mirror, heartbeat -- one binary, role chosen by subcommand), built from source on Wolfi. Tracks Linkerd's edge-YY.M.P releases -- linkerd/linkerd2 has cut only edge builds since stable-2.14.10 (2024-02-20), Buoyant gates true "stable" builds commercially. Ships the newest patch of the last 3 edge year.month lines (26.6/26.7/26.8). Boots against a baked-in, unreachable kubeconfig for the standalone smoke test; a real deployment points it at a live cluster via the chart.

name: linkerd-extension-init
summary: Linkerd extension-init, the Job the Linkerd Viz chart runs to label its namespace (extension and pod-security labels), built from source in Rust from the linkerd/linkerd-extension-init release tag the viz chart pins.

name: linkerd-policy-controller
summary: Linkerd's Rust policy controller (policy-controller), serving Linkerd's authorization-policy CRDs to the proxy data plane over gRPC. Built from source from the same linkerd/linkerd2 monorepo tag as linkerd-control-plane; uses rustls + aws-lc-rs (an ordinary, Cargo.lock-pinned Rust dependency, not a vendored fixed-version OpenSSL download). Image only, no chart (ships as a container in the control plane's destination Deployment).

name: linkerd-proxy
summary: linkerd2-proxy, Linkerd's Rust data-plane sidecar (mTLS termination and meshed traffic routing) -- a from-scratch Rust proxy with no bundled C++ engine, unlike Istio's Envoy fork, so it is genuinely buildable from source here. Built from linkerd/linkerd2-proxy, a separate repo/release cadence version-paired to each linkerd-control-plane release via upstream's own .proxy-version pin. Image only, no chart (ships inside meshed pods via the injector, not deployed standalone).

name: linkerd-viz-metrics-api
summary: Linkerd Viz metrics-api, the Prometheus-backed stats API behind the Viz dashboard and linkerd viz stat, built from source from the same linkerd/linkerd2 edge tags as linkerd-control-plane.

name: linkerd-viz-tap
summary: Linkerd Viz tap, the tap API server and (with the injector argument) the tap-injector webhook the Viz chart runs from the same image, built from source from the same linkerd/linkerd2 edge tags as linkerd-control-plane.

name: listmonk
summary: Self-hosted newsletter and mailing-list manager with campaigns, templates, subscriber lists and an API, on PostgreSQL. One static binary built from source with its admin UI packed in, on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: litellm
summary: LiteLLM proxy, one OpenAI-compatible API to call, route, budget and log 100+ LLM providers. MIT build from PyPI in a Python 3.13 venv on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base, serving on 4000; the proprietary litellm-enterprise package is excluded and the build fails if it appears.

name: litestream
summary: Streaming replication for SQLite databases to object storage such as S3, GCS, and Azure. Image only, no chart.

name: livekit
summary: WebRTC SFU server for scalable real-time audio, video, and data. Single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; config via mounted YAML or LIVEKIT_ env.

name: Loki
summary: Horizontally scalable log aggregation system from Grafana that indexes only labels, not full log text. Like Prometheus, but for logs. Licensed AGPL.

name: longhorn-engine
summary: The Longhorn v1 data engine image, built from source. It carries the static longhorn binary (with libqcow) that the engine-image DaemonSet installs on each node, tgt with Longhorn's backing store, sg_raw and longhorn-instance-manager, at the native commits Longhorn pins per release. Drop-in for upstream's image, runs as root like upstream.

name: longhorn-instance-manager
summary: Longhorn's instance manager, which runs engine and replica processes on each node, built from source with tgt, liblonghorn, libqcow and sg_raw at the commits Longhorn pins per release. V1 data engine only (the default); the SPDK-based v2 engine is not built into this image yet. Drop-in for upstream's image, runs as root like upstream.

name: longhorn-manager
summary: The Longhorn manager (control plane DaemonSet, CSI driver and REST API) built from the longhorn/longhorn-manager source, with the launch-manager and nsmounter scripts and the host tools upstream ships (nfs, cifs, e2fsprogs, xfsprogs, nsenter). Drop-in for upstream's manager image under upstream's Longhorn chart; runs as root like upstream.

name: longhorn-share-manager
summary: Longhorn's share manager, which serves ReadWriteMany volumes over NFSv4. The Go daemon and Longhorn's nfs-ganesha fork (with its longhorn recovery backend) are built from source at the commits Longhorn pins per release. Drop-in for upstream's image, runs as root like upstream.

name: longhorn-ui
summary: The Longhorn web UI, a webpack bundle built from source on Node 20 with its bundled axios, lodash, immutable, d3-color, follow-redirects and form-data moved to fixed releases, served by nginx with upstream's launcher and /v1 proxy to longhorn-manager. Drop-in for upstream's image, uid 499 like upstream.

name: lychee
summary: Lychee: photo management with albums, sharing, smart albums, EXIF and map views and a REST API. PHP 8.5 on Wolfi php-fpm and nginx, SQLite by default; runs as uid 1001 serving 8080 with photos in /var/lib/lychee.

name: maddy
summary: Maddy: a composable all-in-one mail server (SMTP MX and submission, IMAP, DKIM, SPF, DMARC, MTA-STS, local mailboxes) in one binary. Pure Go built from source; runs as uid 1001 on ports above 1024 with config, credentials and mail on a volume.

name: mailpit
summary: Email and SMTP testing tool with a web UI for capturing and inspecting messages during development.

name: MariaDB
summary: Community-developed relational database and drop-in MySQL successor, GPL-licensed and fully open. Default MySQL-compatible engine for the catalog.

name: mariadb-operator
summary: MariaDB Operator, which runs MariaDB and Galera clusters on Kubernetes from CRDs: provisioning, replication and multi-primary HA, backups, users and grants. Built from source; the same binary serves the controller, webhook and the init, agent and backup containers.

name: mastodon
summary: Mastodon, the federated social network server (web and sidekiq). Built from the release tag on a hardened Wolfi ruby-4.0 runtime with every gem compiled from source against Wolfi's libvips, libpq, ICU and libxml2, and the web assets compiled at build time, so no Node ships at runtime. Nonroot, read-only rootfs; PostgreSQL and Redis are external. The streaming server is a separate image.

name: mastodon-streaming
summary: The Mastodon streaming API server (Node), the companion to the mastodon image, on a hardened Wolfi nodejs-24 runtime with only the streaming workspace's production dependencies. Nonroot, read-only rootfs. Image only, no chart; the mastodon chart deploys it.

name: matomo
summary: Matomo, the self-hosted web analytics platform and a privacy-respecting alternative to Google Analytics: you keep the raw data. Built from the official release tarball on a hardened Wolfi php-8.3-fpm runtime fronted by nginx built from source (nonroot, read-only rootfs, supervisord), with the vendored twig/twig replaced by 3.28.0 to clear 14 advisories the shipped 3.11.3 carries. The tarball ships no composer.lock, so the recipe re-materialises the dependency inventory from vendor/composer/installed.php purely so scanners can enumerate what is vendored.

name: mattermost
summary: Open-source, self-hosted team messaging and collaboration platform (a Slack alternative) with channels, direct messages, file sharing, and integrations. Packaged from Mattermost's official Team Edition server release; requires an external PostgreSQL.

name: maven
summary: JDK base image with Apache Maven, used as the build stage for Maven projects; run the resulting jar on jre. Line 3.9.

name: mealie
summary: Recipe manager and meal planner with recipe import from URLs, shopping lists, cookbooks and a REST API, on SQLite or PostgreSQL. Built from source (Nuxt frontend embedded in the Python app) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: mediamtx
summary: Real-time media server and proxy for RTSP, RTMP, HLS, WebRTC, and SRT. Single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; config via a mounted mediamtx.yml.

name: mediawiki
summary: MediaWiki, the wiki engine behind Wikipedia. The official release on a hardened Wolfi php-8.3-fpm + nginx runtime (nonroot, read-only rootfs), with the vendored guzzle and webauthn libraries floated to their fixed releases by a targeted composer update. Ships 1.43 LTS and the supported stable lines. The chart installs the schema on first start, into SQLite by default or an external MySQL or PostgreSQL.

name: Meilisearch
summary: Fast, typo-tolerant full-text search engine with an instant-search API, easy to embed for site and in-app search with relevant results out of the box.

name: Memcached
summary: Simple, high-performance distributed in-memory cache for storing small objects and database query results to reduce backend load.

name: memos
summary: Self-hosted note-taking and micro-journal with Markdown memos, tags, a timeline, attachments and an API, on SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL. One static binary built from source with its web app embedded, on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: mercure
summary: Mercure: a real-time push hub (server-sent events) for browsers and apps, with JWT-authorised publishing and private updates, built as a Caddy module. Built from source like upstream's release; runs as uid 1001 on :8080 with keys from the environment.

name: metabase
summary: Metabase open-source edition, self-service BI and dashboards over PostgreSQL, MySQL and many other databases. The official uberjar on Java 25, with lz4-java swapped to a fixed release inside the jar. Its own application database is H2 by default, or PostgreSQL.

name: metallb-controller
summary: MetalLB controller, the cluster-wide half of the bare-metal LoadBalancer. Assigns Service IPs from IPAddressPool CRDs and serves the CRD validation webhook. Built from source as a single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; pairs with metallb-speaker in the metallb chart.

name: metallb-speaker
summary: MetalLB speaker, the per-node half of the bare-metal LoadBalancer. Announces assigned Service IPs over L2 (ARP/NDP) or BGP using the native implementation (FRR mode is not included). Built from source as a single static Go binary on a hardened Wolfi base; the chart runs it with NET_RAW for L2. Image only, no chart of its own; it ships in the metallb chart.

name: metrics-server
summary: Kubernetes Metrics Server, the cluster-wide aggregator of resource usage that backs `kubectl top` and the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler. Scrapes kubelet summary endpoints and serves the metrics.k8s.io API through the aggregation layer; it is a short-term metrics source, not a monitoring backend.

name: microbin
summary: MicroBin: a small pastebin and file-sharing server with private, read-only and encrypted uploads, expiry and an admin page, on SQLite. Rust built from source on Wolfi OpenSSL; runs as uid 1001 serving 8080 with data in /var/lib/microbin.

name: mimir
summary: Horizontally scalable, highly available long-term storage for Prometheus metrics. Single static Go binary (all-in-one or microservices target) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; object storage is the operator's choice.

name: miniflux
summary: Minimalist, opinionated RSS and Atom feed reader with a clean web UI and a REST API. Single pure-Go static binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; needs PostgreSQL at runtime (operator-provided).

name: miniserve
summary: miniserve: a small file server with directory listing, uploads, archive downloads (tar, tar.gz, zip), basic auth, QR codes and native TLS. Rust built from source; runs as uid 1001 serving /srv on 8080.

name: mitmproxy
summary: mitmproxy, the interactive TLS-intercepting HTTP proxy for debugging and testing (mitmdump by default, mitmweb and mitmproxy by command). In a Python 3.13 venv with cryptography from Wolfi, aioquic built against Wolfi's OpenSSL and the Rust extension rebuilt from source with cargo auditable. Local capture mode (root and BPF) is not included.

name: mlflow
summary: MLflow Tracking Server for the ML lifecycle, experiment tracking, model registry, and run metadata over a REST/UI on port 5000. Packaged as the lightweight mlflow-skinny stack (gunicorn + psycopg2 + boto3) on a hardened Wolfi python base; needs an external PostgreSQL backend store and an artifact store (S3 or PVC).

name: mongo-express
summary: Mongo Express, the web admin UI for MongoDB and MongoDB-compatible servers such as FerretDB. The tagged source with its webpack UI bundle and pinned yarn production deps on Node 24 (8081); set ME_CONFIG_MONGODB_URL plus session and cookie secrets.

name: MongoDB
summary: Document (NoSQL) database for JSON-like data. SSPL is not OSI-approved / source-available, not open source; prefer the clean alternative FerretDB or DocumentDB.
cleanAlternative: FerretDB + DocumentDB, MongoDB-wire-compatible and truly open (Apache-2.0 / PostgreSQL).

name: mongodb-exporter
summary: Prometheus exporter that collects MongoDB diagnostic data, replica-set status, and collection statistics and exposes them as metrics for monitoring.

name: mosquitto
summary: Lightweight Eclipse MQTT broker for IoT and pub/sub messaging. Speaks MQTT 3.1/3.1.1/5.0 over TCP, TLS, and websockets; built from source with OpenSSL and a hardened nonroot, read-only-rootfs runtime.

name: mox
summary: mox, a modern full-featured mail server in one Go binary. SMTP with SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MTA-STS, IMAP4, webmail, admin and account web UIs, automatic TLS with ACME. Runs as uid 1001 on unprivileged ports (an image patch skips the root start and privilege drop).

name: MySQL
summary: Widely used open-source relational database for general-purpose OLTP workloads, with broad framework and tooling support.

name: mysqld-exporter
summary: Prometheus exporter that collects MySQL and MariaDB server status, InnoDB, replication, and query statistics and exposes them as metrics for monitoring.

name: n8n
summary: Fair-code workflow automation platform, build integrations and automations across 400+ apps via a visual node editor, with native AI/LLM agent nodes. Node build on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; the flagged transitive npm CVE class is cleared image-side with pinned overrides.

name: n8n-runners
summary: n8n external task-runner sidecar, isolates and executes workflow code (JS/Python) out of the main n8n process for security and scale. Built from source on Wolfi. Image only, no chart.

name: NATS
summary: Lightweight, high-performance messaging system for cloud-native pub/sub and request-reply, with optional JetStream persistence and streaming.

name: nats-jetstream-controller
summary: The NATS JetStream Controller (NACK): manages JetStream streams, consumers, key-value and object stores and accounts on a NATS server from Kubernetes custom resources. Built from source; runs as uid 1001.

name: nats-server-config-reloader
summary: The NATS config reloader sidecar (nats-io/nack), which signals nats-server to reload when its config changes. Built from source. Image only, no chart; the argo-events chart runs it in JetStream EventBus pods.

name: nautobot
summary: Nautobot, the network source of truth and automation platform. A Django fork of NetBox with Jobs, GraphQL, Git-backed data and an app ecosystem, on PostgreSQL and Redis. One image runs uWSGI (with the static files), the Celery worker and beat, and nautobot-server commands.

name: navidrome
summary: Self-hosted music server and streamer compatible with the Subsonic/OpenSubsonic API, with a modern web UI. From source (React UI embedded, CGO+static-musl SQLite) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; music and data on writable volumes.

name: nebula
summary: Scalable overlay network with mutually authenticated, encrypted peer-to-peer tunnels, certificate-based identity and per-host firewall rules; lighthouses handle discovery. nebula and nebula-cert, static binaries built from source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: Neo4j
summary: Graph database for highly connected data, queried with Cypher for traversals and relationship-heavy workloads. Community edition is GPLv3.

name: nessie
summary: Project Nessie, the transactional catalog for data lakehouse tables (Git-like branches and commits over Iceberg, plus the Iceberg REST catalog). The official Quarkus uber-jar on a Wolfi JRE 21.

name: netbird
summary: NetBird client: a WireGuard peer, or a routing peer that gives the mesh access to a network. Runs in userspace netstack mode as uid 1001 by default; kernel WireGuard mode with NET_ADMIN. Built from source; part of the NetBird set (the netbird chart runs them together).

name: netbird-dashboard
summary: NetBird dashboard: the web console for peers, access control, routes and DNS. Next.js built from source, served by nginx on 8080 from a read-only rootfs; OIDC settings come from environment variables at start. Built from source; part of the NetBird set (the netbird chart runs them together).

name: netbird-management
summary: NetBird management: the control plane for peers, users, groups, access policies and the API, with an embedded Dex identity provider; SQLite or PostgreSQL store. Built from source; part of the NetBird set (the netbird chart runs them together).

name: netbird-nblink
summary: NetBird nblink: a userspace NetBird link without the full client. Built from source; part of the NetBird set (the netbird chart runs them together).

name: netbird-relay
summary: NetBird relay server: carries peer traffic over WebSocket when two peers cannot connect directly. Built from source; part of the NetBird set (the netbird chart runs them together).

name: netbird-reverse-proxy
summary: NetBird reverse proxy: exposes services that sit behind NetBird peers on public domains, with ACME certificates. Built from source; part of the NetBird set (the netbird chart runs them together).

name: netbird-server
summary: NetBird combined server: management, signal and relay in one process on one port, with the embedded identity provider. Built from source; part of the NetBird set (the netbird chart runs them together).

name: netbird-signal
summary: NetBird signal server: brokers the connection offers peers exchange to set up direct WireGuard tunnels. Built from source; part of the NetBird set (the netbird chart runs them together).

name: netbird-upload
summary: NetBird upload server: receives the debug bundles clients upload for support. Built from source; part of the NetBird set (the netbird chart runs them together).

name: netbox
summary: NetBox, the source of truth for network and data-center infrastructure. IPAM, DCIM, circuits, virtualization and a REST and GraphQL API. Django on PostgreSQL and Redis; one image runs gunicorn (static files through whitenoise), the RQ worker and migrations.

name: netdata
summary: Per-second infrastructure and application monitoring agent with a REST API and Prometheus export; headless build without the Cloud UI.

name: nextcloud
summary: Nextcloud, the self-hosted file-sync and content-collaboration platform. Reconstructed clean-room on a hardened Wolfi php-8.4-fpm + nginx runtime (nonroot, read-only rootfs); the chart installs via occ and provides a MariaDB backend. Nextcloud is AGPL-3.0-only (strong copyleft).

name: nginx
summary: High-performance web server, reverse proxy, and load balancer for serving static content and fronting application backends.

name: nginx-gateway-fabric
summary: NGINX Gateway Fabric control plane: the F5/NGINX Gateway API implementation. Watches GatewayClass, Gateway, HTTPRoute and its own gateway.nginx.org policy CRDs, provisions an nginx Deployment per Gateway, and pushes generated config to the nginx-agent inside it over gRPC. One binary covers three roles the chart uses -- controller, generate-certs, and the initialize step that runs as the init container of every data-plane pod. Pairs with the nginx-gateway-fabric-nginx data plane, which it version-locks to itself.

name: nginx-gateway-fabric-nginx
summary: NGINX Gateway Fabric data plane: nginx built from source with the njs dynamic module, NGF's own njs scripts and base configs, and nginx-agent v3 alongside it in one container. NGF 2.x configures nginx over an agent gRPC stream rather than a ConfigMap, so the hardened quench nginx image cannot serve this role -- it has no njs module and no agent. Provisioned by the nginx-gateway-fabric control plane, never installed on its own. Image only, no chart.

name: nginx-proxy-manager
summary: Nginx Proxy Manager, the web UI for nginx proxy hosts, redirections, TCP/UDP streams and Let's Encrypt certificates. nginx built from source with the stream module, the backend with pinned production deps, the UI built from source and certbot, run nonroot on a read-only root (ports 8080/8443, admin 8181).

name: nifi
summary: Apache NiFi, the visual dataflow engine for routing, transforming and moving data between systems. Assembled from Apache's binary distribution on Wolfi openjdk-21 (118 NARs, scanned with every NAR unpacked): the Hazelcast cache services NAR is removed and the aws NAR's wire jars move to 6.4.5.

name: node
summary: Hardened Node.js runtime with npm, a CVE-gated, signed nonroot base image for JavaScript apps. Active LTS lines (20/22/24).

name: node-exporter
summary: Prometheus exporter for host-level hardware and OS metrics (CPU, memory, disk, network) on Linux machines.

name: node-feature-discovery
summary: Node Feature Discovery: labels Kubernetes nodes with their CPU, kernel, PCI, USB, memory and OS features, plus custom labels from NodeFeatureRule resources, so workloads can be scheduled onto the hardware they need. All binaries (master, worker, gc, topology-updater) in one image. Built from source; runs as uid 1001.

name: notation
summary: Notation, the Notary Project CLI to sign and verify container images and OCI artifacts against trust policies. Built from source (static Go). Image only, no chart.

name: nsq
summary: Realtime distributed messaging platform. Ships nsqd, nsqlookupd, and nsqadmin as static Go binaries on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; nsqd data path is a writable volume.

name: ntfy
summary: Simple HTTP-based pub-sub notification service for sending push notifications to phones and desktops from any script. From source with the web UI embedded (no Node at runtime) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: nuclei
summary: ProjectDiscovery's template-based vulnerability scanner for web apps, APIs, networks, DNS and cloud configs. Templates are not baked in; fetch them with -ut into a home volume or point -t at your own. Image only, no chart.

name: oauth2-proxy
summary: Reverse-proxy authentication layer that secures upstream apps by delegating sign-in to OIDC and OAuth2 providers.

name: odoo
summary: Odoo Community Edition, the Python ERP and business apps suite (CRM, sales, inventory, accounting, website) backed by PostgreSQL. Built from the nightly source on Wolfi Python 3.13 with its dependencies at their newest releases and the native ones taken from Wolfi. PDF reports need wkhtmltopdf, which is not included.

name: odyssey
summary: Multi-threaded PostgreSQL connection pooler from Yandex, an alternative to PgBouncer for high connection counts (session and transaction pooling, per-route limits, Prometheus metrics). Built from C source against Wolfi OpenSSL on a hardened nonroot base.

name: ollama
summary: Local LLM runtime that pulls, runs, and serves open models (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, and more) behind a simple REST API. CPU-only image; the chart mounts a writable volume for the model store.

name: opa
summary: Open Policy Agent, the CNCF general-purpose policy engine. Evaluates Rego policies over JSON and YAML to enforce authorization, admission control, and configuration rules across the stack.

name: opa-gatekeeper
summary: OPA Gatekeeper, the Kubernetes admission controller for Rego policies (ConstraintTemplates and Constraints, validating and mutating webhooks, audit of existing resources). Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated.

name: OpenBao
summary: Open-source secrets and encryption management for tokens, keys, and certificates, with dynamic secrets and leasing. The Linux Foundation MPL-2.0 community fork of HashiCorp Vault.

name: opencost
summary: Kubernetes cost monitoring and allocation (CNCF). Serves the cost-model API on 9003 as a single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base, with the cloud pricing configs installed where the binary resolves them by default.

name: openfga
summary: Fine-grained authorization engine (Zanzibar-style relationship-based access control) over HTTP and gRPC. From source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; datastore is the operator's choice.

name: opengist
summary: Self-hosted pastebin backed by Git, with a web UI, search, OAuth sign-in and git push or clone over HTTP and SSH, on SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL. Built from source with its frontend embedded, on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base with git.

name: openldap
summary: OpenLDAP slapd, the reference open-source LDAP directory server, with the LMDB (back-mdb) backend and the client tools. Runs nonroot on unprivileged ports 1389/1636 and backs directory-driven auth for the identity stack.

name: openresty
summary: OpenResty, nginx with LuaJIT and the lua-nginx-module set for scriptable proxies and web apps. Built from source on Wolfi against the system OpenSSL, PCRE2 and zlib, shell-free, nonroot, read-only rootfs. Server blocks go in /etc/nginx/conf.d.

name: openscap
summary: OpenSCAP, the SCAP compliance scanner (oscap for XCCDF and OVAL evaluation, datastream validation and reports), with the scap-security-guide content, from Wolfi's packages. Image only, no chart.

name: OpenSearch
summary: Search and analytics suite with a Kibana-style dashboards UI. The Apache-2.0 community fork of Elasticsearch and the recommended open alternative.

name: opensearch-dashboards
summary: The web UI for OpenSearch, for search, dashboards and visualizations. Ships without the security plugins, matching the opensearch image.

name: opensearch-operator
summary: The OpenSearch Operator: runs OpenSearch clusters and OpenSearch Dashboards from Kubernetes OpenSearchCluster resources, with rolling upgrades, scaling, security configuration, TLS and snapshots. Built from source; runs as uid 1001.

name: openssl
summary: OpenSSL command-line tool with a busybox shell, for init containers and jobs that convert or inspect certificates (PEM to PKCS12 keystores, s_client checks). Image only, no chart.

name: OpenTelemetry Collector
summary: OpenTelemetry Collector that receives, processes, and exports traces, metrics, and logs, a vendor-neutral pipeline for telemetry routing.

name: opentelemetry-operator
summary: The OpenTelemetry Operator, which manages OpenTelemetry Collectors (deployment, daemonset, statefulset or sidecar), the target allocator and auto-instrumentation injection. Built from source with its default component versions stamped in.

name: opentofu
summary: Open-source, community-governed fork of Terraform, an infrastructure-as-code CLI. Image only, no chart.

name: openziti
summary: OpenZiti, a zero-trust overlay network that replaces VPNs and open inbound ports. The single ziti binary (controller, edge router, CLI and PKI tooling), built from source CGO-free and run shell-free. ziti controller run, ziti router run, or ziti edge quickstart for an all-in-one test network.

name: oras
summary: ORAS, the CLI that pushes and pulls arbitrary artifacts (SBOMs, signatures, Helm charts, any file) to and from OCI registries. Built from source (static Go). Image only, no chart.

name: orientdb
summary: Multi-model database with graph, document and key-value models, queried with an SQL dialect over a binary protocol and an HTTP API. Standalone only, no distributed mode.

name: ory-hydra
summary: Ory Hydra, the OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect provider. Built from source like upstream's Linux release (cgo, sqlite, hsm, json1); one binary serves the public (4444) and admin (4445) APIs and runs migrations and the admin CLI.

name: ots
summary: OTS, one-time secret sharing. Secrets are encrypted in the browser (AES-256), the server keeps only ciphertext in memory or Redis, and the link self-destructs after one read. One Go binary with the frontend embedded.

name: owncast
summary: Self-hosted live video streaming and chat. Takes RTMP from OBS or ffmpeg, transcodes to HLS for its web player, with chat and an admin UI, on SQLite. Built from source with ffmpeg on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: pairdrop
summary: PairDrop, local file sharing in the browser (an AirDrop alternative). Devices on the same network, paired devices or public rooms exchange files and text peer to peer over WebRTC; the Node server only does the signaling.

name: paperless-ngx
summary: Paperless-ngx: document management that scans, OCRs and indexes paper documents, with tags, correspondents and full-text search, on PostgreSQL and Redis. Django app and Angular UI built from source, without the optional AI stack; runs as uid 1001 on a read-only root filesystem.

name: pentagi
summary: PentAGI: autonomous AI agents that plan and run penetration tests (recon, exploitation, reporting) in tool containers they start through the Docker API, with a web UI. For authorized security testing only (source MIT; EULA limits use to lawful penetration testing). Built from source (pnpm frontend, Go server); runs as uid 1001 on a read-only root filesystem against PostgreSQL with pgvector, HTTP on 8443.

name: percona-xtradb-cluster-operator
summary: The Percona Operator for MySQL based on Percona XtraDB Cluster: synchronous multi-primary Galera clusters with HAProxy or ProxySQL, backups and point-in-time recovery, managed through CRDs. Built from source; it deploys Percona's database images.

name: perl
summary: Hardened Perl interpreter for scripts, text processing, and tooling. A base image to FROM for Perl workloads. Latest stable (5).

name: perses
summary: CNCF dashboards and observability visualization tool with an embedded React UI and 24 default panel/datasource plugins. From source (Node UI build embedded in a static Go binary) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: pgadmin

name: pgbouncer
summary: Lightweight connection pooler for PostgreSQL that fronts thousands of client connections with a small backend pool, cutting per-connection overhead.

name: pgpool
summary: PostgreSQL connection pooler, load balancer and query router. Pools client connections, spreads read-only queries across streaming-replication standbys, and detaches a backend that fails its health check.

name: php
summary: Hardened PHP CLI with common extensions, a base image to FROM for PHP apps. Latest 3 stable lines (8.3/8.4/8.5).

name: phpmyadmin
summary: phpMyAdmin, the web console for MySQL and MariaDB. summary: Pinniped, identity services for Kubernetes (the Concierge federates cluster login to an OIDC or LDAP provider, the Supervisor is an OIDC issuer across clusters), with the pinniped CLI. Built from source; latest only.

name: plone
summary: Plone, the enterprise CMS on Zope; this is the Plone 6 backend (Products.CMFPlone with the plone.restapi REST API) that a Volto frontend talks to. name: pnpm
summary: Node base image with pnpm preinstalled via corepack, used as the build stage for pnpm projects. Lines 10/11.

name: pocket-id
summary: Simple OIDC provider whose users sign in with passkeys only, with an admin UI and API, on SQLite or PostgreSQL. One static binary built from source with its SvelteKit frontend embedded, on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: pocketbase
summary: Open-source backend in a single file with an embedded SQLite database, auth, file storage, realtime subscriptions, and an admin dashboard over a REST API. Pure-Go static binary (UI embedded) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; state on a writable volume.

name: podman
summary: Podman, the daemonless container engine with a Docker-compatible CLI, built from source and run rootless as uid 1001 with crun, conmon, netavark and fuse-overlayfs. name: poetry
summary: Python base image with Poetry for dependency management and packaging, used as the build stage for Python projects. Line 2.

name: polaris
summary: Fairwinds Polaris, the Kubernetes configuration validator. Audits running workloads or YAML files against best-practice checks (security contexts, probes, resources, image tags) from the CLI, a web dashboard on 8080 with /results.json, or an admission webhook.

name: policy-reporter
summary: Policy Reporter, Kyverno's PolicyReport aggregator. Watches PolicyReport results from Kyverno and other engines, serves them over a REST API and Prometheus metrics, and pushes new violations to Slack, Loki, Elasticsearch, webhooks and more. Go from the tagged source with its sqlite store.

name: popeye
summary: popeye: scans a live Kubernetes cluster and reports misconfigurations and resource issues with a score. Pure Go built from source; runs as uid 1001. Image only, no chart.

name: postgres-exporter
summary: Prometheus exporter that collects PostgreSQL activity, replication, and performance stats and exposes them as metrics for monitoring.

name: postgres-operator
summary: Zalando Postgres Operator: highly available PostgreSQL clusters on Patroni from postgresql custom resources, with rolling updates, connection pooling, logical backups and clones. Static Go binary built from source; clusters run on the QuenchWorks spilo image. Runs as uid 1001.

name: PostgreSQL
summary: Advanced open-source relational database (v18.x) with strong SQL, ACID transactions, JSON, and a rich extension ecosystem. Ships pgvector for vector similarity search. The catalog's default SQL engine.

name: PostgreSQL + DocumentDB
summary: PostgreSQL 17 plus the open DocumentDB extension, providing BSON document storage and queries. The storage backend that powers FerretDB v2.

name: PostgreSQL 15
summary: PostgreSQL 15.x build for the Coolify wave, which pins PG 15 (the default postgresql image tracks 18.x). Same hardened build with bundled contrib extensions.

name: postgrest
summary: REST API server that serves a RESTful API directly from a PostgreSQL schema. Shipped as upstream's official prebuilt static binary.

name: powerdns
summary: PowerDNS Authoritative Server, built from the release tarball. Serves zones from LMDB by default, which needs no schema and supports DNSSEC and zone creation over the HTTP API, with the gsqlite3, gpgsql, gmysql and bind backends compiled in. Listens on 5353 as nonroot.

name: powerdns-recursor
summary: PowerDNS Recursor, the caching DNS resolver, built from the release tarball. Serves resolution to RFC 1918 and CGN clients by default (never an open resolver), with DNS over TLS to upstreams and Lua scripting. Listens on 5353 as nonroot.

name: prefect
summary: Prefect, the Python-native workflow orchestration server for data pipelines. prefect from PyPI in a Python 3.13 venv on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; the default command runs the server (API and UI on 4200), and the same image runs workers and flow code.

name: privatebin
summary: PrivateBin: a minimalist pastebin where the server has zero knowledge of the data; pastes are encrypted in the browser (AES-256-GCM), with expiry, burn-after-reading and discussions. The release tree on Wolfi php-fpm behind QuenchWorks' nginx; runs as uid 1001.

name: Prometheus
summary: Metrics collection, storage, and alerting system that scrapes targets and runs PromQL queries. The de-facto cloud-native monitoring TSDB.

name: prometheus-config-reloader
summary: The Prometheus Operator's config sidecar: renders the Prometheus configuration with environment substitution and reloads Prometheus when it or its rule files change. Built from source from the same release as the operator; image only, no chart.

name: prometheus-nats-exporter
summary: The Prometheus exporter for NATS server and JetStream metrics. Built from source. Also runs in the argo-events chart JetStream EventBus pods.

name: prometheus-operator
summary: The Prometheus Operator: runs Prometheus, Alertmanager and their scrape configuration from Kubernetes custom resources (Prometheus, ServiceMonitor, PodMonitor, PrometheusRule, ...). Built from source with the CRDs compiled in; runs as uid 1001.

name: promptfoo
summary: Red teaming and evaluation for LLM apps, agents and RAG. Runs vulnerability scans and regression test suites against model providers from a YAML config, with a local web viewer. Telemetry and update checks are off. Image only, no chart.

name: promxy
summary: Prometheus aggregating proxy. One PromQL endpoint over several Prometheus servers or HA pairs, merging and de-duplicating results so dashboards see one view. One static binary built from source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: proxysql
summary: MySQL-protocol proxy that pools connections, splits reads from writes, routes queries by rule, and fails over between backends. Configured through its admin SQL interface on 6032; clients connect on 6033. The chart supplies backends, users and a remote admin account.

name: psitransfer
summary: PsiTransfer: simple self-hosted file sharing with resumable uploads, expiring links, password protection and an admin page, no database. Node app built from source; runs as uid 1001 on a read-only root filesystem.

name: Pulsar
summary: Cloud-native distributed messaging and streaming platform with multi-tenancy, geo-replication, and tiered storage that separates compute from storage.

name: pulumi
summary: Infrastructure-as-code CLI for managing cloud resources with general-purpose programming languages. Image only, no chart.

name: pushgateway
summary: Prometheus Pushgateway. Accepts metrics pushed by short-lived batch and cron jobs and exposes them for Prometheus to scrape. One static binary built from source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: pyroscope
summary: Continuous profiling database for analyzing CPU, memory, and other resource usage over time. From source with the React UI embedded (no Node at runtime) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: python
summary: Hardened CPython interpreter with pip, a CVE-gated, signed nonroot base image to FROM for Python apps. Ships the latest 3 stable minors (no :latest).

name: Qdrant
summary: Vector database and similarity-search engine for AI embeddings, powering semantic search, recommendations, and RAG with filtered nearest-neighbor queries.

name: questdb
summary: High-performance time-series SQL database for fast ingestion and queries over metrics, financial ticks, and IoT data, with PostgreSQL-wire and InfluxDB line-protocol ingestion.

name: quickwit
summary: Cloud-native search engine for logs, traces, and analytics with sub-second search over object storage. Built from Rust source (UI embedded, no Node at runtime) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; index data on object storage or a writable volume.

name: RabbitMQ
summary: Reliable message broker speaking AMQP plus MQTT and STOMP, with flexible routing, queues, and acknowledgements for decoupling services.

name: rabbitmq-cluster-operator
summary: The RabbitMQ Cluster Operator: provisions, scales and upgrades RabbitMQ clusters from RabbitmqCluster custom resources. Built from source; runs as uid 1001.

name: radicale

name: rallly
summary: Rallly: meeting scheduling polls (a self-hosted Doodle alternative) with email login, calendars and an API, on PostgreSQL. Next.js app built from source with an exact prisma CLI for migrations; runs as uid 1001 on a read-only root filesystem. Without a license key a space has one seat.

name: rclone
summary: Command-line program to sync files and directories to and from dozens of cloud storage providers. Image only, no chart.

name: readeck
summary: Readeck: a read-it-later and bookmark manager that saves full article text and images, with highlights, labels, collections and e-book export. Built from source with Wolfi's SQLite library; runs as uid 1001 with its config and data under /readeck on a volume and the web UI on 8000.

name: Redis
summary: In-memory key-value store used as a cache, message broker, and ephemeral datastore. Shipped under AGPL (not permissive); Valkey is the BSD-licensed open alternative.

name: redis-exporter
summary: Prometheus exporter that scrapes Redis and Valkey runtime stats and exposes them as metrics for dashboards and alerts.

name: redis-operator
summary: The Redis Operator (OT-CONTAINER-KIT): runs Redis standalone, replication with failover, Sentinel and Redis Cluster from Kubernetes resources, with TLS, ACLs and a Prometheus exporter sidecar. Built from source; runs as uid 1001.

name: redmine
summary: Redmine, the Ruby on Rails project management and issue tracker (issues, wikis, time tracking, Gantt, repositories, REST API) backed by PostgreSQL. name: rekor-tiles

name: renovate
summary: Automated dependency-update CLI that opens PRs to keep dependencies current, on a hardened Wolfi Node runtime. Image only, no chart.

name: restic
summary: restic: fast, encrypted, deduplicating backups to local disk, SFTP, S3-compatible stores, Azure, GCS, B2 and the restic REST server. Pure Go built from source; runs as uid 1001. Image only, no chart.

name: rethinkdb
summary: RethinkDB, the realtime document database with changefeeds that push query results to clients as data changes, plus a web admin UI. From Wolfi's source-built apk, run as uid 1001 with data in /data.

summary: The Rook Ceph operator, which runs Ceph clusters on Kubernetes (block, object and file storage through CRDs). Built from source with its vulnerable modules floated, on the same Ceph 20 packages as the ceph image.

name: rqlite
summary: Lightweight, distributed relational database built on SQLite and Raft. Ships rqlited and the rqlite CLI as static (musl) Go binaries on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; data dir is a writable volume.

name: ruby
summary: Hardened Ruby interpreter with Bundler, a base image to FROM for Ruby apps. Latest 3 stable lines (3.2/3.3/3.4).

summary: Hardened Rust toolchain (cargo plus rustc) for build stages; ship the compiled binary on the static base. Latest 3 stable lines (1.94/1.95/1.96).

summary: S3-compatible, high-performance object store written in Rust with a zero-master architecture, positioned as an Apache-2.0 MinIO alternative. Beta/preview.

name: satosa

name: scylla-operator

name: ScyllaDB
summary: High-throughput, low-latency wide-column store, API-compatible with Apache Cassandra and DynamoDB. This 6.x build is the final OSS line under AGPL.

name: sealed-secrets

name: SeaweedFS
summary: Fast distributed storage for blobs, objects, and files (S3 API) built on Facebook's Haystack design, with O(1) disk seeks for billions of small files. Default object store after MinIO restricted its community edition.

name: secrets-store-csi-driver
summary: Secrets Store CSI Driver, mounting secrets from external stores (Vault, cloud KMS) into pods as volumes, built from source.

summary: Selenium Grid 4 server (hub, router, distributor, session queue, event bus, node, standalone; role picked by argument), the upstream release jar on a Wolfi JRE 21.

name: sftpgo

name: shaarli
summary: Shaarli: a personal, minimalist bookmark manager and link sharing service with tags, a daily digest, RSS/Atom feeds and a REST API, stored in flat files. PHP 8.5 on Wolfi php-fpm and nginx; runs as uid 1001 serving 8080 with data in /var/lib/shaarli.

name: shellcheck
summary: Static analysis for shell scripts. Flags quoting bugs, unsafe globbing, and portability issues in sh and bash; pipe a script in with "-" or mount a directory. Image only, no chart.

name: shiori
summary: Bookmark manager with readable offline archives, a web UI, a REST API and a CLI, on SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL. One static binary built from source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; data and archives in /shiori.

name: silverbullet
summary: SilverBullet: Markdown note-taking and personal knowledge platform with Lua scripting, live queries, templates and an offline-capable web app. Rust server with the client embedded, built from source with cargo auditable; runs as uid 1001 on a read-only root filesystem.

summary: Sim realtime: the socket.io collaboration server for the Sim workflow editor (port 3002), built from source and run on Bun. Pairs with the sim image; runs as uid 1001 on a read-only root filesystem.

name: sish
summary: Self-hosted HTTP(S), WebSocket and TCP tunnels over plain SSH, an ngrok alternative where clients need only ssh -R. One static binary built from source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

summary: Enterprise search platform built on Apache Lucene, offering full-text search, faceting, and indexing over large document collections.

summary: SonarScanner CLI, the standalone scanner that analyzes a project and pushes results to a SonarQube server. Bundles its own OpenJDK. Image only, no chart.

name: sops
summary: sops: an editor of encrypted files (YAML, JSON, ENV, INI, binary) with age, PGP and cloud KMS or Vault keys. Pure Go built from source; runs as uid 1001. Image only, no chart.

name: telegraf
summary: Plugin-driven agent that collects metrics, logs, and events from systems and services and writes them to time-series backends. Image only, no chart.

name: Tempo

summary: Highly-available Prometheus setup with unlimited metric retention via object storage, adding a global query view, downsampling, and compaction across Prometheus servers. A CNCF project.

name: thelounge
summary: The Lounge: a self-hosted web IRC client that stays connected, with history, push notifications and file uploads. From npm on Wolfi Node 24 with its pinned dependencies lifted to fixed versions; runs as uid 1001 with THELOUNGE_HOME on a volume and the web UI on 9000.

name: tidb-operator
summary: TiDB Operator: runs TiDB clusters (PD, TiKV and the MySQL-compatible TiDB servers) from TidbCluster resources, with scaling, rolling upgrades and failover. The controller manager, scheduler extender, discovery service and admission webhook are built from source and run as uid 1001; the clusters run PingCAP's own images.

name: tigera-operator
summary: The Tigera operator, which installs and manages Calico from an Installation resource; built from source, pinned to the Calico release the calico-* images ship.

name: tigerbeetle
summary: Distributed financial-grade accounting database for high-throughput double-entry bookkeeping. Ships a single self-contained static Zig binary; speaks its own binary protocol (not HTTP) on port 3000.

name: tika
summary: Apache Tika server, the REST API for extracting text and metadata from PDF, Office, image, archive and 1000+ other formats. The Apache 4.x release on a Wolfi openjdk-21-jre, nonroot, API on 9998.

name: timescaledb
summary: PostgreSQL 17 plus the open TimescaleDB extension (Apache-only edition), adding hypertables, continuous aggregates, and time-series functions for high-ingest metrics and event data. Built clean-licensed from source on Wolfi (no TSL community code).

name: timestamp-authority
summary: The Sigstore Timestamp Authority, an RFC 3161 timestamping server that countersigns artifact hashes, with file, KMS and Tink signers. Built from source; the default in-memory signer is for testing.

name: tinyauth
summary: Tinyauth: a lightweight login portal and forward-auth server for Traefik, nginx and Caddy, with local users, TOTP, OAuth and OpenID Connect providers. Built from source, the web UI with pnpm and embedded in the Go binary; runs as uid 1001.

name: tinyproxy
summary: Tinyproxy: a small HTTP and HTTPS (CONNECT) forward proxy with optional filtering, upstream chaining, reverse and transparent modes. C, built from source, uid 1001, no shell, port 8888; ships a container config that allows loopback and the private ranges.

name: tomcat
summary: Apache Tomcat, the widely used open-source Java servlet container and web/application server for running Jakarta Servlet, JSP, and WebSocket web applications.

name: tomee
summary: Apache TomEE, Tomcat with the Jakarta EE Web Profile stack (OpenEJB, OpenWebBeans, MyFaces, CXF) for running Jakarta EE applications.

name: traccar
summary: Traccar: a GPS tracking server for 200+ device protocols with live maps, geofences, reports, notifications, a React web UI and a REST API. Packaged from the official release on a Wolfi OpenJDK 21 JRE with 23 bundled jars swapped to fixed versions. Runs as uid 1001; web and API on 8082, OsmAnd on 5055, other protocols on their own ports; H2 under /opt/traccar/data or PostgreSQL.

name: Traefik
summary: Cloud-native reverse proxy and load balancer with automatic service discovery, dynamic config, and built-in Let's Encrypt TLS.

name: trafficserver
summary: Apache Traffic Server, a caching HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and TLS reverse and forward proxy, built from source. It listens on 8080 as uid 1001, caches to disk under /var/cache/trafficserver, and answers 404 until a remap rule maps a host to an origin. The chart supplies remap.config and records.yaml.

name: traggo
summary: traggo: tag-based time tracking with dashboards, a web UI and a GraphQL API, on SQLite or PostgreSQL. Go server with the React UI embedded, both built from source; runs as uid 1001 on a read-only root filesystem.

name: trickster
summary: Caching reverse proxy and accelerator for time-series databases (Prometheus, InfluxDB, ClickHouse) and plain HTTP origins; delta proxy caching makes repeated dashboard range queries cheap. One static binary built from source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: trilium
summary: Trilium Notes: hierarchical note-taking with rich text, code notes, scripting, ETAPI and sync, on SQLite. Node server built from source (TriliumNext); runs as uid 1001 on a read-only root filesystem.

name: trino
summary: Trino, the distributed SQL query engine for federated analytics. Assembled from upstream's release assets on Wolfi openjdk-25 with the jmx, memory, tpcds, tpch and postgresql connectors; the airlift launcher is rebuilt from source. Fault-tolerant execution and the spooling protocol (exchange-filesystem, spooling-filesystem) are left out.

name: trivy
summary: Aqua Security's all-in-one vulnerability, misconfiguration, secret, and SBOM scanner for images, filesystems, and repositories. Image only, no chart.

name: trivy-operator
summary: Trivy Operator, the Kubernetes operator that continuously scans workloads, configurations, RBAC and the cluster with Trivy and stores the results as CRDs (VulnerabilityReport, ConfigAuditReport, ...). Built from source with the coherent module floor.

name: trivy-scanner
summary: The QuenchWorks trivy build with a busybox userland, for the scan Jobs Trivy Operator launches (they run a shell command line around trivy). Image only, no chart; the trivy-operator chart uses it.

name: trufflehog
summary: TruffleHog, the secret scanner for git history, filesystems, S3, Docker images and more. Built from source (static Go) with git and ssh included for repository scans; self-update is off. Image only, no chart.

name: trust-manager
summary: trust-manager, cert-manager's trust bundle distributor. A Bundle resource gathers CA certificates from ConfigMaps, Secrets and inline PEM and writes the bundle into every selected namespace. Static Go from the tagged source.

name: tusd
summary: Reference server for the tus resumable-upload protocol. Uploads survive dropped connections and resume at the last byte; stored on disk or S3, GCS or Azure, with hooks for processing. One static binary built from source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: tyk
summary: Full-featured API gateway with rate limiting, auth, and quotas. Single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; Redis is a runtime dependency the operator provides.

name: typesense
summary: Fast, typo-tolerant search engine with an instant-search REST API and a self-contained embedded store (no external database), tuned for low-latency site and in-app search.

name: umami
summary: Privacy-focused web analytics without cookies (page views, events, funnels, sessions) on PostgreSQL, with a small tracker script and a REST API. Built from source (Next.js standalone, Prisma 7) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; migrates its database on start.

name: unbound
summary: Unbound, the validating, recursive, caching DNS resolver from NLnet Labs. Built from source with libevent, expat and dnscrypt; a nonroot config on port 5053 with DNSSEC validation and answers for private ranges only.

name: unleash
summary: Unleash, the feature-flag and gradual-rollout server (flags, strategies, segments, environments, admin UI, client and frontend APIs) on PostgreSQL. The official npm distribution on Wolfi Node 24, two dependencies raised to fixed releases. AGPL-3.0 since 8.0.

name: uptime-kuma
summary: Uptime Kuma, the self-hosted uptime monitor and status-page server (HTTP, TCP, ping, DNS, database and more). The tagged server with pinned npm production deps and the release's prebuilt UI on Node 24; SQLite in DATA_DIR by default.

name: uv
summary: Python base image with uv, a fast Rust-based installer and resolver, used as the build stage for Python projects. Line 0.11.

name: Valkey
summary: BSD-licensed in-memory key-value store, the truly-open community fork of Redis 7.2. QuenchWorks' default cache and the recommended Redis drop-in replacement.

name: varnish
summary: HTTP reverse-proxy cache (web accelerator) that fronts an origin and serves its responses from memory, cutting backend load and tail latency. Caching policy is VCL, which varnishd compiles to native code at startup. The chart supplies the VCL and the backend.

name: vault
summary: Secrets and encryption management for tokens, keys, and certificates, with dynamic secrets, leasing, and PKI. Shipped under the Business Source License 1.1, which is not OSI-approved; OpenBao (MPL-2.0) is the open drop-in fork. Built from source with the web UI included; the chart supports multi-node raft HA. The 1.20.x line is CVE-blocked upstream and not shipped.

name: vaultwarden
summary: Bitwarden-compatible password manager server for the official Bitwarden clients and browser extensions, with the web vault, on SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL. Built from source (Rust, auditable) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: vcluster
summary: vCluster, virtual Kubernetes clusters that run inside a namespace of a host cluster. The syncer is built from source (CGO off, floated modules); the control plane it runs, kube-apiserver and kube-controller-manager 1.36.4 built from the Kubernetes tag with kine on SQLite, ships in the same image, so no initContainer copies binaries in.

name: Vector
summary: High-performance observability pipeline that collects, transforms, and routes logs, metrics, and traces between sources and sinks.

name: velero
summary: CNCF backup and disaster-recovery tool for Kubernetes cluster resources and persistent volumes. Single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; object-store and snapshot backends are the operator's choice.

name: velero-plugin-for-aws
summary: Velero's object-store and volume-snapshot plugin for AWS S3 and S3-compatible stores (SeaweedFS, Garage, RustFS, MinIO). Built from source; runs as an init container that copies the plugin into Velero. Image only, no chart.

name: versitygw
summary: Versity S3 Gateway, an S3-compatible API server that fronts a POSIX filesystem, another S3 service or Azure Blob, with IAM accounts and a built-in web UI. The default command serves the posix backend from /data on 7070 with a /health endpoint; root credentials come from ROOT_ACCESS_KEY and ROOT_SECRET_KEY.

name: vertical-pod-autoscaler
summary: Vertical Pod Autoscaler: the recommender, updater and admission-controller that size pod CPU and memory requests from observed usage. All three built from the kubernetes/autoscaler release tag into one image (vpa-recommender, vpa-updater, vpa-admission-controller), nonroot.

name: victorialogs
summary: Fast, cost-efficient logs database with the LogsQL query language. Single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; log data lives on a writable volume.

name: VictoriaMetrics
summary: Fast, cost-efficient time-series database that speaks PromQL and Prometheus remote_write. Drop-in long-term storage or full replacement for Prometheus.

name: victoriametrics-operator
summary: The VictoriaMetrics Operator: runs VMSingle, VMCluster, VMAgent, VMAlert, VMAuth, VictoriaLogs and their scrape configuration from Kubernetes custom resources, and also reads Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor and PodMonitor objects. Built from source; runs as uid 1001.

name: victoriametrics-operator-config-reloader
summary: The config-reloader sidecar the VictoriaMetrics Operator injects into the pods it runs: renders configuration from Secrets and triggers reloads. Built from source; runs as uid 1001.

name: vikunja
summary: Self-hosted to-do and project management app (lists, kanban, gantt, calendar) serving both the API and the Vue web UI. From source with the UI embedded on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; SQLite or an external SQL database.

name: vitess
summary: Horizontal sharding, connection pooling and failover for MySQL. Ships the core command set as one image (vtgate, vttablet, vtctld, vtctldclient, vtorc, mysqlctl, mysqlctld, vtbackup) as static Go binaries on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; a deployment picks its component by overriding the command. Image only, no chart.

name: vitess-operator
summary: The Vitess Operator: runs Vitess (horizontally sharded MySQL) from Kubernetes VitessCluster resources, with vtgate, vttablet, vtctld, topology on etcd, resharding and backups. Built from source; runs as uid 1001.

name: vllm
summary: vLLM, the high-throughput LLM inference and serving engine with an OpenAI-compatible API. CPU build, installs vLLM's prebuilt CPU wheel (torch+cpu, no source compile, no CUDA) into a venv on a hardened Wolfi python-3.12 base, gated on fixable CVEs across ~140 Python packages. The user supplies the model; the chart runs it as a StatefulSet with a persistent model cache.

name: volcano
summary: Volcano: batch scheduler and job controller for AI, ML and HPC workloads on Kubernetes (gang scheduling, queues, fair share, Job and PodGroup resources). One image with the scheduler, controller manager and webhook manager. Built from source; runs as uid 1001.

name: vouch-proxy
summary: SSO for nginx auth_request. Logs users in through OIDC or OAuth (Google, GitHub, Okta, Keycloak, any OIDC issuer), sets a JWT cookie and answers /validate for each request, so apps with no login of their own sit behind SSO. One static binary built from source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: wakapi
summary: Self-hosted, WakaTime-compatible backend for coding statistics, with a web UI and API, on SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL. One static binary built from source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: wallos
summary: Wallos: self-hosted subscription and recurring-cost tracker with multiple currencies, notifications (email, Discord, Telegram, ntfy, webhooks and more), statistics and TOTP 2FA, on SQLite. The release on Wolfi php-fpm behind QuenchWorks' nginx with upstream's schedule under supercronic; runs as uid 1001.

name: warpgate
summary: Warpgate, a bastion (jump host) for SSH, HTTPS, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, RDP and VNC with single sign-on, per-target access and session recording, no client agent needed. Built from source (Rust with cargo auditable, the web UI with Node); runs as uid 1001 with its config and data under /data.

name: weaviate
summary: Open-source AI-native vector database for semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation, with hybrid keyword plus vector queries.

name: wikijs
summary: Wiki.js: a wiki with Markdown and visual editors, Git sync and many auth providers, on PostgreSQL. Node app built from source (frontend, content blocks and backend); runs as uid 1001 on a read-only root filesystem.

name: wildfly
summary: WildFly, the Jakarta EE application server, on a Wolfi openjdk-21 JRE. Nonroot, read-only rootfs (all runtime writes under /tmp), HTTP on 8080 and management on loopback. Its bundled OpenTelemetry family is moved to 1.62.0 for a CVE, with each module descriptor rewritten to match.

name: wiremock
summary: WireMock, the HTTP API mock server (stubs, response templating, proxying and recording, fault injection, request journal, admin API) on Jetty 12. Assembled from its unshaded Maven artifacts with vulnerable families pinned, on a Wolfi JRE 21.

name: woodpecker
summary: Lightweight, container-native CI/CD engine (a Drone-compatible fork) with a server, agent, and CLI. From source (Vue UI embedded in the static Go server) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: wordpress
summary: WordPress, the PHP content-management system and blogging platform. Reconstructed clean-room from the official release on a hardened Wolfi php-8.4-fpm + nginx runtime (nonroot, read-only rootfs, supervisord), not the php:apache upstream image. The image ships no wp-config.php; the chart supplies one via ConfigMap and provides a MySQL backend.

name: writefreely
summary: WriteFreely: a minimalist publishing platform with ActivityPub federation, Markdown and collections, on SQLite or MySQL. Built from source with Wolfi's SQLite library; runs as uid 1001 with the database and keys on a volume and the web UI on 8080.

name: wstunnel
summary: wstunnel: tunnels TCP, UDP, SOCKS5 and stdio over WebSocket or HTTP/2 to get through proxies and firewalls, server and client in one binary. Rust built from source with cargo auditable and the ring crypto provider; runs as uid 1001, the server on 8080 by default.

name: xyops
summary: xyops, a workflow-automation and server-monitoring system (job scheduler, monitors, alerting, ticketing) by the creator of Cronicle. Built from source on Wolfi nodejs-22 (native better-sqlite3), nonroot on a hardened read-only-rootfs base. Single-instance with an embedded SQLite store on a persistent volume; the chart runs it as a StatefulSet.

name: yara
summary: YARA: pattern matching for malware research and incident response; rules match strings, byte patterns and module facts (PE, ELF, .NET, DEX, Mach-O, hashes, file magic). C, built from source with OpenSSL and libmagic, uid 1001, no shell. Image only, no chart.

name: yarn
summary: Node base image with Yarn preinstalled, used as the build stage for Yarn projects. Lines 1 (classic) and 4 (berry).

name: yarr
summary: yarr: a self-hosted RSS and Atom reader with a web UI, a Fever API for mobile clients and an optional login, on SQLite. Built from source, the Vue frontend bundled with esbuild and the cgo SQLite build linked statically; runs as uid 1001.

name: yopass
summary: Yopass: share secrets through one-time links; the browser encrypts with OpenPGP before upload and the server keeps only ciphertext in Memcached or Redis with an expiry. Go server, yopass CLI and the React web UI built from source; runs as uid 1001 on a read-only root filesystem.

name: yourls
summary: YOURLS, the self-hosted URL shortener with click stats, an admin UI and an API. The release tarball on Wolfi php-fpm behind QuenchWorks nginx (8080), configured entirely from YOURLS_* environment variables; needs MySQL or MariaDB.

name: yq
summary: yq: a portable command-line YAML, JSON, XML, CSV, TOML and properties processor with jq-like syntax. Pure Go built from source; runs as uid 1001. Image only, no chart.

name: zabbix-server
summary: Zabbix server, the collector and alerting engine of the Zabbix monitoring platform, built from source with the PostgreSQL backend. Ships the database schema under /usr/share/zabbix. SNMP checks are not included (Wolfi net-snmp has no MD5).

name: zabbix-web
summary: Zabbix web frontend (PHP) on nginx and php-fpm, PostgreSQL backend, configured from ZBX_DB_* environment variables. Pairs with zabbix-server of the same version.

name: zap
summary: OWASP ZAP web application security scanner (intercepting proxy, spider, active scan) as a headless API daemon or one-shot scanner, on the Wolfi JRE. log4j swapped to 2.26.1; commons-httpclient 3.1's CVE-2012-5783 is VEXed with code evidence. Chart runs the API daemon.

name: zipkin
summary: Zipkin, the distributed tracing server (HTTP, gRPC, Kafka, RabbitMQ and ActiveMQ collection, the query API and the Lens UI on 9411). The official exec jar with 66 library jars swapped to fixed releases; the legacy Pulsar and Scribe collectors are removed.

name: zipline
summary: Zipline: file and image sharing server with a web UI, ShareX/Flameshot uploads, URL shortening, folders, invites, OAuth and passkeys, on PostgreSQL. Node 24 app built from source with pnpm; runs as uid 1001 on a read-only root filesystem.

name: zitadel
summary: Cloud-native identity and access management (IAM) with OIDC/OAuth2/SAML, multi-tenancy, and a built-in admin console. Packaged from ZITADEL's official prebuilt binary; event-sourced store on an external PostgreSQL.

name: ZooKeeper
summary: Centralized coordination service for distributed systems, providing configuration, naming, leader election, and synchronization primitives.

name: zoraxy
summary: Zoraxy, the general-purpose reverse proxy with a web UI (virtual hosts, ACME certificates, stream proxy, uptime monitor), AGPL-3.0. Built from source with the web UI embedded and gorilla/csrf moved to 1.7.3 with a plain-HTTP patch for the admin panel; the bundled ZeroTier of upstream's image is left out. Admin panel on 8000 as uid 1001.

name: zot
summary: OCI-native container registry (registry, sync, and dist-spec surface). Built from source as a static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; filesystem storage under a writable volume.

name: ztunnel
summary: Istio's ambient-mode node proxy (ztunnel, Rust), built from source from the istio/ztunnel tags on the same three lines as istiod, with aws-lc TLS and jemalloc as upstream builds it, over Wolfi iptables.
